## Kill shadow state: intent lives in the triefact tree — 2026-07-25 (parent 911b300a4c50)

The session replaces the `session_log` module (and its `record_applied`/`read_entries`/cursor machinery) with a new `pending_intent` module that owns a single `.pending.md` file bridging `patch apply` and the next digest write. Key new symbols: `append_intent`, `read_intent`, `consume_intent`, `pending_path`, `PENDING_BASENAME`, `_flatten`, `_ROW_RE`, `_SESSION_RE`. `record_intent` in `edits/pipeline` now writes to `.pending.md` instead of the session log; `_covered_qnames` in `intent_gate` reads from the pending file; `_run_digest_write` calls `consume_intent` after writing.

Additionally, `render_digest_section` now stores overflow rows beyond `max_changes` in a `trie:changes-overflow` HTML comment so gate coverage and amend folding remain lossless; `_parse_digest_file` reads that comment back. The sync-bot workflow (`install_sync_bot_workflow`, `render_sync_bot_workflow`) and its tests are deleted. `rows_from_digest_entry` is added to `session_diff`.
